Rashi on Shevuot 8a:10:1.hebrew: ואימא יולדת - שאם עבר עליה יום הכפורים אוכלת בקדשים בלא קרבן:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:10:1.english: And say [that the goat atones for] a woman after childbirth - for if Yom Kippur passed over her [before she brought her offering], she may eat sacrificial foods without [bringing her] offering:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:10:2.hebrew: ולא לכל טומאתם - וקרבן יולדת אינו בא לכפרה, אלא לטהרה מטומאתה, לאכול בקדשים:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:10:2.english: And not for all their impurities - The offering of a woman after childbirth does not come for atonement, but to purify her from her impurity, [so that she may] eat sacrificial foods.

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:11:1.hebrew: ולרבי שמעון דאמר כו' - במסכת נדה בפרק המפלת (נדה דף לא:):
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:11:1.english: And according to Rabbi Shimon, who said, etc. - [This is discussed] in tractate Niddah, in the chapter [entitled] HaMapelet (Niddah, page 31b):

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:11:2.hebrew: יולדת חוטאת היא - שכשכורעת לילד נשבעת שלא תזקק לבעלה:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:11:2.english: A woman after childbirth is a sinner - For when she crouches to give birth, she swears that she will not have relations with her husband:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:11:3.hebrew: ממקומו הוא מוכרע - ואיהו רבי שמעון לא צריך להך דרשה דחלק:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:11:3.english: From its own place it is determined - And he [Rabbi Shimon] does not need that derivation of "chalak" [the division]:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:12:1.hebrew: מה חלק דמייתי צפרים - לא גרסינן, שאין זה להקל, שהצפרים אינן קריבין, ולבד הקרבן הם באין <abbr title="שבעה">ז'</abbr> ימים לפני הקרבן. והכי גרסינן: אימא מצורע, וחלק דידיה לא מיצטריך לפרושה, דהא פריש גבי קושיא דיולדת, ומאי חילוק דמייתא בעולה ויורד, והיא גופה איתא במצורע:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:12:1.english: "What differentiates [him] is that he brings birds" - we do not have this reading, because this is not a leniency, as the birds are not offered [on the altar], and they come separately from the offering, seven days before the offering. Rather, this is the reading: "Say [that it atones for] a leper," and his differentiation did not need to be spelled out, since it was already stated in the challenge regarding a woman who gave birth: "And what is the differentiation, that she brings a burnt offering and a sliding-scale offering?" — and that very [feature] is found in the case of a leper:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:13:1.hebrew: ז' דברים - מפרש במסכת ערכין בפרק יש בערכין. אלמא על חטאת אתי קרבן דיליה:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:13:1.english: Seven matters - [The Gemara] explains [them] in tractate Arachin, in the chapter [entitled] Yesh Be'Arachin. Evidently, his offering comes on account of a sin-offering [i.e., for sin]:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:13:2.hebrew: התם מנגעיה איכפר ליה - בצער נגעו נתכפר לו העון:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:13:2.english: There, through his leprous mark he is atoned - Through the suffering of his leprous mark, the sin was atoned for him:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:14:1.hebrew: ואימא נזיר טמא - דכתיב (במדבר ו׳:י׳) "וביום השמיני יביא שתי תורים":
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:14:1.english: But say [that the goat atones for] a ritually impure nazirite - For it is written (Numbers 6:10): "And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves."

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:14:2.hebrew: ולא לכל טומאתם - וכי מייתי נזיר קרבן, למיחל עליה נזירות טהרה מייתי, כדכתי' (שם): "והזיר לה' את ימי נזרו, והימים הראשונים יפלו", וגזרת הכתוב הוא דלא חיילא נזירות עד דמייתי קרבן:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:14:2.english: And not for all their impurities - And when a nazirite brings an offering, he brings it so that the nazirite status of purity will take effect upon him, as it is written (there): "And he shall consecrate to the Lord the days of his nazirite vow, and the first days shall fall away." It is a decree of the verse that the nazirite status does not take effect until he brings an offering:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:15:1.hebrew: דרבי אלעזר הקפר - מבואר במסכת תענית (דף יא.):
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:15:1.english: [The statement] of Rabbi Elazar HaKappar - [is explained] in tractate Taanit (11a):

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:15:2.hebrew: חוטא הוא - שציער עצמו מן היין:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:15:2.english: He is a sinner - because he afflicted himself [by abstaining] from wine:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:16:1.hebrew: כי היכי דעביד לפני ולפנים - דמפרש לעיל במנינא: אחת למעלה, וז' למט' מדם הפר, וכן מדם השעיר; ואתא האי "וכפר על הקדש" לאיתויי היכל, שיעשה כמו כן על הפרוכת מבחוץ:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:16:1.english: In the same manner that he performs in the innermost sanctum - as [the Gemara] explained above with regard to the counting: one [sprinkling] upward and seven downward, from the blood of the bull, and likewise from the blood of the goat. And this [verse], "And he shall effect atonement upon the Sanctuary," comes to include the Sanctuary [i.e., the Heichal], [teaching] that he should do the same [sprinklings] toward the curtain on the outside:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:17:1.hebrew: נייתי פר ושעיר אחריני קמ"ל - דכתיב וכפר, מההוא גופיה, והדר כתיב וכן יעשה, לפרושי מה היא כפרה, שהכתוב מצוה עליו שיהא ככל אשר עשה לפנים:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:17:1.english: He should bring another bull and goat; [the verse] teaches us - [that it is written,] "And he shall effect atonement," [meaning] from that very [bull and goat]; and afterward it is written, "And so shall he do," to clarify what that atonement is — that the verse commands him that it should be like all that he did earlier:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:17:2.hebrew: מיניה משמע - ואייתר ליה לרבי שמעון "וכפר על הקדש" לדרשה:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:17:2.english: It is indicated from it - And [the phrase] "and he shall effect atonement upon the Sanctuary" is thus left over for [Rabbi Shimon] for [another] derivation:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:18:1.hebrew: ה"ג מאי ניהו, יש בה ידיעה כו' ולא גרסינן "טומאה במקדש מאי ניהו". והכי פירושא: קתני "מה פשעים שאינן בני קרבן, אף חטאים", ומאי ניהו טומאה דממעיט מהאי קרא? ההיא דבת קרבן, ואיזו זו? שיש בה ידיעה בתחלה וידיעה בסוף:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:18:1.english: So the text reads: "What is it? One in which there was awareness..." etc. And we do not read [in the text], "[Defilement of the Temple] — what is it?" And this is the explanation: It teaches, "Just as [the] rebellious acts [are] those that are not subject to an offering, so too [the] sins [are such]"; and what is the defilement that is excluded from this verse? It is that which is subject to an offering, and which is that? One in which there was awareness at the beginning and awareness at the end:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:18:2.hebrew: האי בר קרבן - עולה ויורד הוא, ולמה לי למימר דלא ניכפר האי שעיר עלה:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:18:2.english: This one is subject to an offering - He [brings] an offering of variable value (oleh v'yored), so why do I need [the verse] to say that this goat should not atone for him?

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:19:1.hebrew: סמוך לשקיעת החמה - של ערב יום הכפורים, ולא היה שהות להביא קרבנו:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:19:1.english: Close to sunset - on the eve of Yom Kippur, and there was not enough time to bring his offering:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:4:1.hebrew: אי נמי בהנך דלאו בני גלות - הרבה שנויין במסכת מכות (פ"ב), כגון שהרגו דרך עלייה, או מי שיצאה אבן מתחת ידו והוציא הלה ראשו וקבלה:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:4:1.english: Alternatively, [it refers] to those [cases] that are not subject to exile - There are many [such cases] taught in tractate Makkot (chapter 2), for example, where he killed him [by falling] while going up a ladder, or one from whose hand a stone flew out, and the other [person] put out his head and received it:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:6:1.hebrew: מה חלק - בטומאת מקדש משאר טומאות:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:6:1.english: What differentiates - [the impurity] of the Temple from other [types of] impurities:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:6:2.hebrew: דמייתי עולה ויורד - חלק הוא, ושאר שגגת עבירה מכפרת בקרבן קבוע:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:6:2.english: That one brings a sliding-scale offering - [this is the distinction], whereas [for] other unintentional transgressions [one brings] a fixed offering:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:8:1.hebrew: דמייתי שעירה ולא כשבה - ובשאר חייבי כריתות, או כשבה או שעירה מביא:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:8:1.english: That he brings a she-goat and not an ewe - whereas for other [transgressions punishable by] karet, [one brings] either an ewe or a she-goat:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:9:1.hebrew: חלק להקל קאמרינן - האי "מה מצינו שחלק" הכתוב חילוק שהוא להקל, מיבעי לן לאשכוחי דומיא דשעיר הפנימי, דקולא הוא שיחיד מתכפר בקרבן צבור, שלא חסר בו ממון משלו:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:9:1.english: We said [that the Torah] differentiates to be lenient - This [argument], "what do we find where [the Torah] differentiated," [means that] we need to find a differentiation that is for leniency, similar to the inner goat [offering], for it is a leniency that an individual is atoned for through a communal offering, [in that] he is not diminished in money from his own [funds]:

Rashi on Shevuot 8a:9:2.hebrew: והאי חלוק להחמיר - שאם לא ימצא שעירה אלא בדמים יקרים, יביאנה בעל כרחו:
Rashi on Shevuot 8a:9:2.english: And this is a differentiation to be stringent - For if he does not find a goat except at a high price, he must bring it against his will:

Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:10:2.hebrew: אמר קרא לכל חטאתם - וא"ת, קרבן יולדת נמי איקרי חטאת? וי"ל, דבעי שבא על חטאת דומיא דפשעים. ולא מצי לשנויי "אמר קרא וכפר", דביולדת נמי כתיב "וכפר", והיינו שמכפרה ומטהרה לאכול בקדשים:
Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:10:2.english: The verse states: "For all their sins" - And if you ask: The offering of a woman after childbirth is also called a sin-offering? And one can answer: [The Gemara] requires [an offering] that comes for a sin, similar to [the case of] intentional transgressions. And it could not answer, "The verse states, 'and he shall atone,'" since with a woman after childbirth too it is written "and he shall atone," and that means that it atones for her and purifies her to eat sacred foods:

Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:12:1.hebrew: ואימא מצורע ומאי חלק וכו' - ואם תאמר, והא מייתי נמי אשם? וי"ל, בחטאת שלו מיהא חלק להקל:
Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:12:1.english: And say [that it atones for] a leper, and what is the difference, etc. - And if you say: But he also brings a guilt offering! And one can answer: In his sin offering, at least, [the Torah] differentiated him, to be lenient:

Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:13:1.hebrew: על ז' דברים נגעים באין - תימה, והא לא מייתי בעלמא קרבן אהנך עבירות אלא כשהוא מצורע, והיכי תיסק אדעתין דאחטאה קמייתי? ונראה לריב"ן דס"ד דאתרוייהו מייתי, לכפרה ולאשתרויי בקהל, ומשני דלאו לכפרה מייתי, אלא לאשתרויי בקהל:
Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:13:1.english: For seven matters leprous marks come - It is astonishing: for in general [the Torah] does not bring an offering for those sins except when he is a leper, so how could it enter our mind that he brings it on account of having sinned? And it appears to the Riva"n that [the Gemara] thought that he brings it for both: for atonement and to be permitted into the congregation; and [the Gemara] answers that he does not bring it for atonement, but only to be permitted into the congregation:

Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:14:1.hebrew: אימא נזיר טמא - פירוש, שנזיר טמא ולא ידע שנטמא. ומאי חלק? דמייתי תורין, אע"ג דמייתי נמי אשם, מכל מקום הקרבן שחייבו הכתוב לבד מאשם חלק להקל:
Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:14:1.english: Say [that it atones for] a ritually impure nazirite - Meaning, [a nazirite who became impure] and did not know that he became impure. And what is the distinction? That he brings doves, even though he also brings a guilt offering; nevertheless, the offering that the verse obligated him [to bring] aside from the guilt offering is a distinction, [which is] a leniency:

Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:15:1.hebrew: ולרבי אלעזר הקפר דאמר נזיר חוטא הוא כו' - ואם תאמר: והא לא איקרי חוטא אלא לפי שציער עצמו מן היין, והשעיר אינו בא לכפר אלא על הטומאה! ויש לומר: כיון שעל ידי הטומאה בא לו שציער עצמו מן היין פעם שניה, כדאמר בנזיר (דף ג. ע"ש) ששנה בחטא, קרינן ביה "וכפר מטומאתו". ודוקא לרבי אלעזר הקפר, אבל לרבנן אפילו נטמא במזיד, הקרבן אינו בא על החטא, דהא אפילו נטמא באונס, דלאו חוטא הוי לרבנן, מביא קרבן. ו"מאשר חטא על הנפש" הוי לרבנן לשון חסרון, כמו (מלכים א א׳:כ״א) "והייתי אני ובני שלמה חטאים", וכמו (שופטים כ׳:ט״ז) "אל השערה ולא יחטיא". "ולכל חטאתם" ליכא לפרושי הכא לשון חסרון הוה, דהא דומיא דפשעים כתיב:
Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:15:1.english: And according to Rabbi Elazar HaKappar, who says: A nazirite is a sinner, etc. - And if you say: But he is called a sinner only because he afflicted himself by abstaining from wine, whereas the goat comes to atone only for the impurity! One can answer: Since it is through the impurity that he came to afflict himself from wine a second time, as stated in Nazir (3a, see there) — that he repeated the sin — we read of him, "and he shall atone for his impurity." And this is specifically according to Rabbi Elazar HaKappar; but according to the Rabbis, even if he became impure intentionally, the offering does not come for the sin, since even if he became impure unintentionally, in which case he is not a sinner according to the Rabbis, he brings an offering. And "for that which he sinned regarding the soul" is, according to the Rabbis, an expression of deficiency, like [in] (I Kings 1:21) "I and my son Solomon will be sinners [i.e., found wanting]" and like (Judges 20:16) "at a hair, and not miss." But "and for all their sins" cannot be explained here as an expression of deficiency, for it is written parallel to "transgressions":

Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:19:1.hebrew: דאתידע ליה סמוך לשקיעת החמה - ואם תאמר: הא נמי נילף משעיר המשתלח, דבדידיה נמי דרשינן "חטאים" דומיא דפשעים? ויש לומר: דלא דרשינן ביה דומיא דפשעים, אלא לענין אם נודע לו מבעוד יום, שראוי להביא קרבן; אבל סמוך לשקיעת החמה, ל"א חשיב בר קרבן. להכי אייתר בשעיר הפנימי "חטאים" דומיא דפשעים, דאפי' אתיידע ליה סמוך לשקיעה לא תלי:
Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:19:1.english: That he became aware close to sunset - And if you say: Let us derive this too from the scapegoat, for with regard to it as well we expound "sins" as analogous to "transgressions"? And one can say: We do not expound it as analogous to "transgressions" except with regard to a case where he became aware of it while it was still day, when he was fit to bring an offering; but close to sunset, he is not considered one who is [fit] to bring an offering. Therefore the word "sins" analogous to "transgressions" is superfluous in the case of the inner goat, [to teach] that even if he became aware close to sunset, it [the atonement] is not suspended:

Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:1:1.hebrew: גילוי עריות כו' אי במזיד בר קטלא הוא - ובהנך דליכא קטלא אלא כרת, ליכא לאוקומה, דהא איכא למיפרך "בר מלקות הוא", כדפרישית:
Tosafot on Shevuot 8a:1:1.english: Forbidden sexual relations, etc. If intentionally, he is subject to the death penalty - And with regard to those [forbidden relations] for which there is no death penalty but only karet, one cannot establish [the Gemara's case there], for one can refute it [by saying], "He is subject to lashes," as I explained:
